text:
```yaml
name: Release Please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install -g @release-please/cli

    - name: Run Release Please
      run: npx release-please --repo=joshuafuller/ATAK-Maps --release-type=auto --path=./ --target-branch=main --config-file=.release-please-config.json

    - name: Document how to run Release Please
      run: |
        echo "To run Release Please for publishing new versions:"
        echo "1. Ensure you have the necessary permissions."
        echo "2. Navigate to the root directory of the repository."
        echo "3. Execute the command: npx release-please --repo=joshuafuller/ATAK-Maps --release-type=auto --path=./ --target-branch=main --config-file=.release-please-config.json"
```

This workflow sets up a basic Release Please process for the `joshuafuller/ATAK-Maps` repository. It triggers on pushes to the `main` branch, checks out the code, sets up Node.js, installs the `@release-please/cli`, and then runs Release Please with the specified configuration. The documentation step provides instructions on how to manually trigger the release process.
